subject: [Doculyra][ACTION REQUIRED][DEC-FWK-001] Enforce protected main and environment gates
requiredAction: Choose the GitHub plan/publicity and solo-owner review policy in Issue #1.
reason: The current private repository plan does not expose branch protection or rulesets, and no GitHub Environments are configured.
recommendation: Keep the repository private, upgrade to a protection-capable plan, require PRs and Phase 1 checks now, and require one independent approval only after a second authorised reviewer exists.
alternatives: Make the repository public and configure protection.
Remain private with procedural controls only.
